lines.text: i wanna please everybody
'specially people who are never sorry
i can't express the pressure in my chest
feeling bereft of executive function
rollercoasting down and up
i am never enough
i wanna be disembodied
from this never ever ending quandary
cast off the mind in its precious but blind
attempts to unwind what is destined to break
the i that seeks its end
the last point of contention
i didn't choose this nor can i diffuse it
the truth will be true in no matter what light
my heart filled with sorrow doubts all tomorrows
and in letting it there is a glimpse of the peace i have sought on my knees
there is no one to please
not even in here
glowing avenues open up
nothing was always enough
what i sought to empower is being devoured
and the pain is ecstatic expression of life
the power it wielded is finally yielded
surrendered it floats as a mote in the wind it never has sinned
the illusion has thinned and there's nothing but love
nothing but love
nothing but love
nothing
nothing

n1.body:
the b side of the album is very vey dear to my heart and marks the first art i created since the beginning of an ongoing and eternal journey of self-discovery. i had taken a strong interest in transcendental meditation and was beginning to uncover views of reality wholly new and quite literally mind-blowing.

old coping strategies reach their expiration date
without them who even am i?

n2.body: a belief i discover i have

n3.body: chasing this desire and that, avoiding other things - so much running!

n4.body: the untrained mind is easily swayed and its goals are not aligned with the higher purpose

n5.body: and tend to be rather small picture

n6.body: when the ego begins its training to work not only in favor of its own maintenance anymore

n7.body: unlike what my time and culture lead me to believe there do seem to be universal truths

n8.body: faith in its infancy is a fragile thing

n9.body:
peace and stillness can be found within
freedom and love

n10.body:
just being who you are is all that was ever asked

(as in plenty star trek episodes in which the ship tries to escape an unknown phenomenon which is draining all energy supplies rapidly, the wise captain at some point realizes the only hope is in making the leap of faith and in order to escape this tight grasp all they must do is let go themselves)

n11.body:
pain can be worked with in powerful ways
like everything else fundamentally it is energy

n13.body: finally the soul rests and life is more enjoyable
